capabilities: Sync Todoist tasks bidirectionally with Obsidian
extras: README defers all install and usage instructions to external documentation; the plugin is unaffiliated with Doist and accepts donations via 'buying a coffee'.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync tasks with Todoist, so tasks managed there don't appear in notes.

relations.evidence: offers the ability to have your Todoist tasks sync bidirectionally with Obsidian

summary: Unofficial plugin that syncs Todoist tasks bidirectionally with Obsidian, materializing them inside notes.
